svg.text: ATLAS B03-GEO | MEASURED CITY MASTER RC1 v0.3.1
Grid 340 x 225 proposed cells (56x28 isometric art tile). Drawing north is NOT geographic north. Cell dimensions and plots are original.
19 stable places (LF-03 dashed conditional); 7 inherited crossings; 75 parent nodes / 86 parent relations. Public route scope unchanged.
Street lines are UNTESTED 2D proposal; potential water/frontage conflicts listed separately in QA. No runtime routes or collision approvals.
Hydrology is original metric shape; The Cut joins the Ankh below the Isle. Existing game doors and case anchors are READ-ONLY.
